a4a8d1407b54.text: Feel first: a draft appears the moment you act and input never waits on FreeCAD; FreeCAD catches up and the wave confirms it.

c736a42607db.text: Typed values follow what you're doing: the direction you drag, and the model's units for a bare number; any unit you type, written however you write it, is understood.

193b00b0cacf.text: Refer to geometry, never to FreeCAD's internal numbers.

119a36d022c6.text: Relationships stay live: copies, arrays, mirrors and fits follow later edits, and you can detach one on purpose.

3b97b911fdc1.text: Show what an edit will change before it does.

3fa59e25b2a2.text: Never lose work: always saved, atomically, and undo crosses sessions without hiding changes made in FreeCAD.

a2b6c5b8eeda.text: Work splits by files, and one integrator merges, numbers and keeps the records.

2a256b8ac812.text: A rejected action says why and leaves nothing behind.
